headline: England expands free pharmacy access to emergency contraception
summary: Almost 305,000 women used England’s free morning-after pill pharmacy service in its first five months, NHS England says.
script: In England, more than three hundred thousand women used a new free morning-after pill service at community pharmacies in its first five months. The NHS says access is now closer to home.
